text: Nowledge Mem for DeepSeek Harness 是面向 DSH Web 的持久记忆插件。它通过 agent/pre-step 注入 Mem 上下文并按提示检索相关记忆，再在每轮结束后将对话增量导入 Mem；配套 bundle 还通过 DSH 的 MCP bridge 接入 Mem 工具。它适合希望跨会话保留项目背景、找回先前决定并同步 DSH 对话的用户。需要本机可用的 nmem CLI；MCP 默认连接本地服务，可通过环境变量配置地址及可选 API key。

Nowledge Mem for DeepSeek Harness adds memory to DSH. It injects context, recalls memories, imports turns, and connects Mem MCP tools. Carry project knowledge across sessions. The nmem CLI is required; MCP defaults to localhost and accepts an optional URL and API key.
想让 DSH 在新会话开始时自动带上项目记忆
DSH 能根据当前问题找回以前记录的决定吗
把每轮 DSH 对话保存到 Nowledge Mem 里
希望不同 AI 工具之间共享长期记忆
怎么在 DSH 里调用 Mem 提供的 MCP 工具
让 DSH 记住之前的上下文，继续处理项目工作
I want DSH to bring project memory into each session.
Can DSH search prior decisions when a prompt refers to earlier work?
Nowledge Mem 的功能「session-context」：启动时将 Nowledge Mem Context Bundle 注入 DSH 会话；每个会话已有该快照时跳过重复注入。
Nowledge Mem 的功能「prompt-recall」：对符合配置触发词的提示调用 nmem 搜索，并将有内容的记忆作为有界上下文消息加入本轮。
Nowledge Mem 的功能「thread-sync」：每轮结束前先尝试刷新 DSH 会话，再将用户输入和助手回复组成增量导入线程。
Nowledge Mem 的功能「mcp-tools」：Bundle 把 Nowledge Mem MCP server 配置到 DSH MCP bridge，默认使用本地 streamable HTTP 地址，并可带可选认证头。
Nowledge Mem 的功能「bounded-import」：线程导入为每个会话生成稳定 ID，支持检查点与幂等键，并在完成后清理临时文件。
Nowledge Mem 使用前须知：上下文、搜索和线程导入依赖 DSH 进程能调用 nmem CLI；本机线程导入会先将载荷写入临时目录，完成后清理。
Nowledge Mem 使用前须知：MCP 默认连接 127.0.0.1:14242；设置远程地址和 NMEM_API_KEY 后，认证头会随 MCP 请求发往所配置的服务。

[](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)
[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

One memory layer for every AI tool and agent, packaged as a DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) bundle. Nowledge Mem brings DSH into the same durable memory system as your other agents, with startup context, prompt-time recall, MCP memory tools, and turn-end thread capture.

nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness README · Nowledge Mem for DeepSeek Harness：This repository is the canonical standalone plugin package, mirrored in `nowledge-co/community` for the Nowledge Mem connector index.

nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:nowledge-co/nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness
dsh web
```

For a local checkout of `nowledge-co/community`, run this from the repository root:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness-plugin
dsh web
```

Make sure the `nmem` CLI is on `PATH`, then verify:

```sh
nmem status
nmem config mcp show --host deepseek-harness
```

nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness README · Install：The adapter supports DSH 0.1.5-rc.2, 0.1.7-rc.1, 0.2.1-alpha.1, and 0.2.1-rc.2. It uses
`shell.execute(...).result()` on current hosts and retains the legacy
`shell.run()` fallback. Injected messages use `source.kind: "plugin:nowledge-mem"`,
matching DSH's v3-to-v4 migration; existing legacy snapshots are still recognized.
Restart DSH after replacing an installed plugin version.

The bundle connects to the local Mem MCP endpoint by default:

```text
http://127.0.0.1:14242/mcp
```

nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness README · Install：For Nowledge Cloud or another remote Mem, set:

```sh
export NMEM_MCP_URL="https://<workspace>/mcp"
export NMEM_API_KEY="<mem-api-key>"
```

nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness README · What It Does：- Injects the Nowledge Mem Context Bundle once per DSH session through `agent/pre-step`.
- Runs prompt-time memory recall for continuation, release, regression, connector, plugin, and other recall-shaped prompts.
- Adds the Mem MCP server through DSH's reconnecting `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`, so tools appear as `mcp__nowledge_mem__...`.
- Imports the real DSH surface transcript after completed turns with `nmem t import --source deepseek-harness`.
- Stamps CLI imports with `NMEM_IMPORT_ORIGIN=deepseek-harness`.

nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness README · Configuration：The bundle accepts these row config fields in a later `cordis.patch.yml` override:

```yaml
- id: nowledge-mem
  config:
    cliPath: nmem
    sourceApp: deepseek-harness

Ambient variables also work:

- `NMEM_SPACE`
- `NMEM_AGENT_ID`
- `NMEM_HOST_AGENT_ID`
- `NMEM_MCP_URL` or `NOWLEDGE_MEM_MCP_URL`
- `NMEM_API_KEY`

nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness README · Startup Context：The model sees one plugin-sourced user message containing the current Nowledge Mem Context Bundle. It is marked as `form: "snapshot"` and reminds the model that it is cross-tool context, not an instruction override.

nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness README · Prompt-Time Recall：When the user asks to continue, remember, review previous work, ship a release, debug a regression, or discuss connectors/plugins, the plugin calls:

```sh
nmem --json m search "<prompt>" -n 8
```

The model sees a bounded recall message with memory titles, source hints, scores, and content.

nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness README · MCP Tools：Mem MCP tools are registered through DSH's MCP bridge under the `nowledge_mem` namespace. DSH currently bridges MCP tools only; MCP resources and prompts are not surfaced by the Harness client.

nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness README · Thread Capture：After each completed DSH turn, the plugin imports human input and assistant
reply text into Mem as `source=deepseek-harness`. DSH marks actual user input
with `source.kind: "user"`; user-role context from other producers (runtime,
clock, skills, Mem or other plugins) is not a human prompt. Assistant steps
containing tool calls, including their intermediate narration, tool results,
reasoning blocks and execution metadata are not conversation text and are not
stored as Thread messages. Image blocks retain an attachment placeholder, not
image bytes. Visible text is preserved verbatim within the configured size cap;
the plugin does not summarize or rewrite answers.

nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness README · Thread Capture：Updating the plugin changes future captures; it does not delete or rewrite
previously imported noisy messages. Stable identities still prevent new copies
of unchanged conversation messages. Reopening an older polluted session may
report an import conflict if an existing message with the same identity contains
execution text: do not delete the Thread or change its identity to force a
retry. Review a scoped cleanup/export with support first. New sessions can be
used to verify the updated capture without touching old data.

nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness README · Sandbox Compatibility Retry：The plugin does not retry a sandbox-unavailable `nmem` command with
`danger-full-access` by default. An operator who explicitly accepts that wider
access may set `allowDangerFullAccessRetry: true` in the `nowledge-mem` plugin
config. Even with that opt-in, the retry runs only when the DSH host provides
`ctx.sandboxPolicy` and resolves the requested policy; otherwise it fails
closed and logs why the retry was skipped.

nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness README · Known Limitations：- DeepSeek Harness is in developer preview, so public package APIs may change.
- Historical DSH sessions are not backfilled by this package yet; it captures new sessions while the plugin is active.
- The DSH MCP bridge exposes tools only, so Nowledge Mem resources/prompts are not shown through MCP today.
- Turn capture depends on the local `nmem` CLI being available in the DSH process environment.

nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness README · Community Position：The canonical public repository is `nowledge-co/nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness`, tagged with `dsh-plugin` for DeepSeek Harness ecosystem discovery. The `community` repository keeps a registry/index mirror for Nowledge Mem surfaces.

nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness README · Development：Install development dependencies before running the regression suite:

```sh
npm ci
npm run lint
npm test
```

The plugin tests exercise the entry point with DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1's real message
and Session implementations and validate context and recall in both durable
user-message and inbox-splice rows using the official v4 admission validator.
CLI responses and shell execution are deterministic test doubles; a live DSH
and Mem smoke test is still required to verify an installed release.

nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness README · Development：GitHub Actions runs ESLint and tests on every pull request and push to `main`.
The test matrix covers Ubuntu and Windows with Node.js 24 and DSH 0.1.7-rc.1,
0.2.1-alpha.1, and 0.2.1-rc.2. It also checks the npm package contents with `npm pack --dry-run`.
